title: Essay Outliner — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Organizes essay arguments and sections into a clear working outline. The Essay Outliner organizes essay arguments into a clear outline. It takes the thesis and the main points, arranges them in a logical order with supporting evidence under each, and checks that every section connects back to the thesis. The result is a working skeleton the student can write from, with transitions planned between sections.
capabilities: Arrange thesis and main points in logical order
Attach supporting evidence to each section
Check every section against the thesis
Plan transitions between sections
Produce a writable outline skeleton
